button.title: Buttons
button.description: One button, several appearances and sizes. The same component changes through its options.
button.options: variant changes appearance; size changes dimensions; disabled blocks interaction; onClick belongs to the caller.
button.variants: Variants — different styles of the same button

input.title: Text inputs
input.description: Text entry and the shared search-field variant.
input.options: Use Input for regular fields and SearchInput for search. Supply a label and describe invalid input.
input.name: Example name

textarea.title: Multiline inputs
textarea.description: Multiline text using the shared focus treatment.
textarea.options: Accepts native textarea props: value, onChange, rows and disabled.

toggle.title: Switches
toggle.description: A controlled on/off switch shared by settings, workspaces and channels.
toggle.options: The caller owns checked and onChange. label supplies its accessible name.

select.title: Selection controls
select.description: A single choice with keyboard navigation and disabled options.
select.options: Compose Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent and SelectItem. The root owns value/onValueChange.

segmented.title: Segmented choices
segmented.description: A short, always-visible set of choices.
segmented.options: value, options and onChange are controlled. mode="tabs" adds arrow-key tab navigation.

combobox.title: Searchable choices
combobox.description: Searchable options with shared keyboard and pointer navigation.
combobox.options: useComboboxNavigation supplies input/list/option props; the caller filters values and owns selection.

chevron.title: Control chevron
chevron.description: The shared chevron used by selection controls.
chevron.options: className may adjust placement. The icon is decorative; the owning control supplies its accessible name.

dialog.title: Dialogs
dialog.description: A modal editor with staged changes, nested selection and focus return.
dialog.options: The caller owns open/onOpenChange and draft/save behavior. Always provide DialogTitle and a description when useful.
dialog.help: Changes apply only to this preview.
dialog.label: Example label

alert.title: Confirmation dialogs
alert.description: An explicit confirmation with separate cancel and action controls.
alert.options: Compose title, description and footer; perform the action in AlertDialogAction's handler.
alert.help: This changes only the preview state.

sheet.title: Side panels
sheet.description: A modal panel attached to an edge of the viewport.
sheet.options: SheetContent supports side. Include SheetTitle and SheetDescription.
sheet.help: Supporting controls beside the current page.

popover.title: Popovers
popover.description: A small interactive surface anchored to its trigger.
popover.options: Compose trigger and content; open/onOpenChange can be controlled. Content follows the owning dialog's portal.

menu.title: Dropdown menus
menu.description: Actions, radio choices, nested menus and disabled entries.
menu.options: Use onSelect for actions and a radio group for a persistent choice.

tooltip.title: Tooltips and hints
tooltip.description: HoverHint composes the shared tooltip primitives; tooltip.tsx is their public import surface.
tooltip.options: Use HoverHint for ordinary hints. Keep essential errors visible. Hover and keyboard focus share the product's timing rules.
tooltip.primitiveHelp: Shared pointer delay and immediate keyboard focus.
tooltip.hintHelp: A composed hint with the same focus and pointer behavior.

truncated.title: Truncated text hints
truncated.description: Shows a hint only when the measured text is truncated.
truncated.options: Supply text and a constrained width. Add tabIndex when the text itself should receive keyboard focus.

disclosure.title: Collapsible content
disclosure.description: Expandable content that preserves child state while folded.
disclosure.options: Disclosure owns expansion; DisclosureContent accepts a controlled open prop for custom triggers.
disclosure.help: This draft survives closing and reopening.

expandable.title: Expandable text
expandable.description: A line-limited preview of the same mounted text.
expandable.options: The caller owns expanded. lines sets the collapsed line count; provide an accessible toggle.

imageViewport.title: Image viewport
imageViewport.description: Image-local fit, zoom, pan and pinch controls.
imageViewport.options: Supply a bounded className and remount for a different image identity. Set panWithArrows=false when a gallery owns arrow navigation.

streaming.title: Animated labels
streaming.description: A shared text animation for active thinking and tool labels.
streaming.options: active controls animation. String or number children supply the glyph overlay; reduced-motion settings are respected.

markdown.title: Markdown replies
markdown.description: The production streaming renderer, including tables, code and math.
markdown.options: children is Markdown text. streaming controls incomplete content; onOpenFilePreview belongs to the screen.

code.title: Code display
code.description: Syntax highlighting, line numbers, clipboard copying, ANSI output and viewport-aware rows.
code.options: code and language supply content; showLineNumbers, wrapLongLines and chrome control presentation. Viewport highlighting requires line numbers and unwrapped lines.

math.title: Math formulas
math.description: The shared fitting wrapper around Markdown's rendered display math.
math.options: Use MarkdownText for TeX source. DisplayMath itself accepts already-rendered math nodes and scales them to the available width.

message.title: Messages
message.description: User and assistant messages, including thinking and delivery states.
message.options: message is a UIMessage projected by the chat runtime. Data and network actions remain outside the renderer.

activity.title: Agent activity
activity.description: Activity primitives composed into a working, completed or failed sequence.
activity.options: Pass text, status and controlled expansion. The gateway owns tool execution; these components render its projected state.

files.title: File edits
files.description: File references, line-change counts and expandable diffs.
files.options: edits contains display summaries; displayMode selects summary/diff/collapsed_diff; onOpenFilePreview is supplied by the screen.
files.error: Example edit could not be applied.
files.hint: Select a file reference to exercise its callback.

imageGallery.title: Image thumbnails
imageGallery.description: Multi-image layout, thumbnail selection and overflow.
imageGallery.options: images supplies URLs and names; size selects large or compact thumbnails, align controls alignment. Only four thumbnails are shown; the composed ImageLightbox includes all viewable images.
imageGallery.hint: Select a thumbnail or +2 to view all six images.

imageLightbox.title: Full-screen image viewer
imageLightbox.description: Controlled full-screen viewing and image navigation.
imageLightbox.options: index is null when closed. The caller owns index and open callbacks; ImageLightbox composes ZoomableImage and resets the view on image changes.
imageLightbox.hint: Use previous/next, ←/→ or Home/End; close with × or Escape.

zoomableImage.title: Image zoom
zoomableImage.description: Single-image zoom, bounded panning and gestures.
zoomableImage.options: src and alt supply one image. Place it in a positioned container with a defined height; remount when changing images. Focus the viewport for +, − and 0 keyboard controls.
zoomableImage.hint: Zoom with +/−, double-click, Ctrl+wheel or pinch. Drag or scroll to pan after zooming; click the percentage or press 0 to reset.

attachment.title: Attachments
attachment.description: Image preview, video playback, file download and unavailable attachments.
attachment.options: attachment.kind selects image, video or file. Images open ImageLightbox, videos use native controls, files use download links. Missing URLs render unavailable tiles; failed image loads also render an unavailable tile.

fileReference.title: File references
fileReference.description: A file reference with a caller-owned open action.
fileReference.options: path supplies the label; onOpen supplies the action. The component does not decide workspace permissions.

settingsComposition.title: Settings composition
settingsComposition.description: The actual settings row/group/capability components composed with shared controls.
settingsComposition.options: The containing settings controller owns values and persistence. A gallery callback updates only local preview state.
settingsComposition.switchHint: A shared setting row with a controlled switch.

modelPickers.title: Model pickers
modelPickers.description: Choose a provider, search for or enter a model ID, and adjust reasoning effort.
modelPickers.options: The caller supplies ProviderPicker values and actions. ModelIdPicker's models can supply a fixed catalog; ReasoningEffortPicker's savedValues supplies existing options.

providerIcons.title: Provider icons
providerIcons.description: Compare regular, compact and fill sizes, and the picker's unconfigured state.
providerIcons.options: provider selects an existing icon; compact and fill control size. showBrandLogos=false uses built-in icons.

timezone.title: Timezone picker
timezone.description: Search by timezone name, Chinese name or UTC offset, then view the same instant in local time.
timezone.options: value is an IANA timezone; onChange updates the caller's value. The component provides search and keyboard navigation.

textEditor.title: Text editor and hints
textEditor.description: Open the editor to change, save or cancel. Clear the content and save to see error feedback.
textEditor.options: SettingsTextEditor closes after onSave succeeds and shows errors on failure; SettingsHint opens on hover, focus or click.
textEditor.hint: Open the editor to change, save or cancel. Clear the content to see the error state.
textEditor.help: After saving, the updated content appears below.

removePreset.title: Remove model presets
removePreset.description: Delete unused model presets and view the disabled state of the preset used by the default model.
removePreset.options: This is the delete button used by ModelsSettings; the caller supplies disabled and the delete action. Provider management uses the ProvidersSettings dialog.
removePreset.primaryHint: The preset used by the default model cannot be deleted.

loading.title: Loading layouts
loading.description: Switch loading layouts for app, channel and skill catalogs, and view the shared status container.
loading.options: CatalogSkeleton's layout selects the layout. SkeletonStatus uses label for screen-reader status and marks decorative content as aria-hidden.

sidebar.title: Settings navigation
sidebar.description: Select sections, handle a pending restart, and narrow the browser to view the mobile menu.
sidebar.options: activeSection and onSelectSection control selection; back, sign-out and restart actions are caller callbacks.
sidebar.hint: Choose a settings section, or narrow the browser to see mobile navigation.

providerSearch.title: Provider search
providerSearch.description: Search providers grouped by OAuth, API key and local access, then select an entry or a custom provider.
providerSearch.options: providers is the existing catalog. query is a controlled search value; onSelect and onCustom pass selection to the parent.
providerSearch.hint: Search providers, or use arrow keys to choose.

requestParameters.title: Request parameters
requestParameters.description: Edit headers, query parameters and request body; enter invalid JSON to see real validation feedback.
requestParameters.options: fields selects visible entries; form holds JSON text. Headers and query parameters accept only string values; the request body accepts any JSON object values.

requestAPI.title: Request API controls
requestAPI.description: Select supported provider APIs, the default API, model overrides and fallback options.
requestAPI.options: ProviderAPIControl keeps at least one API. ModelAPIControl allows null for automatic selection and shows available APIs based on provider capabilities.

usage.title: Token usage
usage.description: Switch between data, empty records and unavailable states. Hover over bars for daily usage; open details for model trends.
usage.options: usage is a caller-supplied statistics record; timeZone defines date boundaries. The details dialog and charts only display supplied data.

overview.title: Settings overview
overview.description: View the current model, capability status and usage; select feature rows to try section navigation.
overview.options: settings supplies overview data; onSelectSection receives the selected settings section.

web.title: Web search settings
web.description: Switch between providers requiring no credentials, an API key or a server URL; adjust search options and try autosave.
web.options: settings holds the current configuration; form holds edited values. The parent supplies save, credential visibility and provider switching actions.

image.title: Image generation settings
image.description: Toggle image generation, choose from a fixed model catalog, aspect ratios and image sizes, and expand advanced options to adjust the count.
image.options: form is controlled configuration; dirty marks changes. The component reuses provider credentials; the parent implements saving.

voice.title: Transcription settings
voice.description: Toggle transcription; edit the model, language, duration and upload size limits; try autosave.
voice.options: settings supplies provider information; the parent manages form and save callbacks.

safety.title: Access settings
safety.description: Toggle local service access and default permissions; view setting rows, hints and autosave feedback.
safety.options: form supplies display values; onSave handles save requests. Runtime permission enforcement remains the gateway's responsibility.

channelCatalog.title: Channel catalog and identity
channelCatalog.description: Switch running, starting, failed and uninstalled states; try the switch, installation entry and help menu.
channelCatalog.options: feature supplies installation and runtime states. The parent handles onAction and onSelect; identity, errors and help use the same channel data.
channelCatalog.hint: Use the switch or install button to see state changes.

credentials.title: Channel credentials
credentials.description: Enter credentials, reveal or hide secrets, apply connection presets, check required fields and copy a helper command.
credentials.options: fields defines groups and controls; values and visibleSecrets are controlled. requirements defines credential combinations; preset and save callbacks update only this example.
credentials.hint: Fill in credentials, toggle secret visibility, or apply a connection preset.

channelValidation.title: Connection checks
channelValidation.description: Switch between checking, success and failure; watch checks appear in sequence with an identity summary.
channelValidation.options: validation supplies check records; validating controls loading. The component only displays the results.

runAt.title: Scheduled time picker
runAt.description: Enter a date and time, or open the calendar and choose with the mouse, arrow keys and page keys.
runAt.options: value uses YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm local time; onChange returns the edited value. Invalid input is shown on the existing form control.

automationCalendar.title: Automation calendar
automationCalendar.description: Change months, switch schedules and history, and select successful or failed records to open results. Narrow containers automatically show an agenda.
automationCalendar.options: jobs and month determine calendar content. onInspect handles scheduled jobs; the caller supplies result display through renderRunDialog. The calendar does not read services.
automationCalendar.hint: Select a run record to view its result, or choose a scheduled job.

providers.title: Provider management
providers.description: View the actual provider management dialog and add-provider flow.
providers.options: Reuses ProvidersSettings from settings. The caller controls the catalog, forms and save callbacks; this preview changes local sample data and supports configuration, search, creation and cancellation.
providers.invalidParameters: Enter valid request parameter JSON; header and query parameter values must be strings.
providers.signedIn: Preview authorization set to signed in
providers.signedOut: Preview authorization set to signed out

runResult.title: Automation run results
runResult.description: Open run results to compare Markdown replies, loading, retry, empty replies and missing history.
runResult.options: result supplies loading state and the retrieved reply. The caller handles onRetry; this view does not read runtime state or request results.

chatBinding.title: Automation run chat
chatBinding.description: Choose the run chat, edit instructions, confirm, switch back or cancel; compare busy jobs, loading errors and conflicts.
chatBinding.options: data and job supply available chats and binding versions. The view manages the confirmation draft; the feature entry connects onSave, onSaved and onReload to data operations.
chatBinding.saved: The next run will take place in {{title}}
chatBinding.hint: Choose a target chat, then confirm or edit the task instructions.

about.title: About and version views
about.description: Compare version-check states, commit links, update entries and the About page; buttons update the view with sample results.
about.options: AboutSettingsView accepts composed version and support links. VersionCheckRowView displays checking/result and requests checks through onCheck. The feature entry owns actual checks and diagnostic link data.
about.error: Could not get version information. Try again.
about.preferenceSaved: Sample preference saved; nothing will be installed or restarted.
about.updateRequested: Update review selected; this preview does not install or restart anything.

appearance.title: Appearance preferences
appearance.description: Toggle appearance, activity display, file diffs and notification preferences; sample values appear below.
appearance.options: The caller manages theme and preferences. onChangeBrowserNotifications delegates permission requests to the feature entry; preview callbacks only change sample switches.

starInvitation.title: Support invitation
starInvitation.description: Open the actual invitation dialog, compare saving and error states, and try postponing, the GitHub link and permanent dismissal.
starInvitation.options: open, saving and error are display states. The existing StarPrompt entry owns claiming invitations and persisting preferences; the view only calls supplied actions.
starInvitation.dismissed: Never remind again selected in preview
